summary: Expanded the node around foodservice disposables, paperboard cup/container inputs, QSR packaging suppliers, and regulatory/testing gates. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate found is Karat Packaging, which is small-cap and explicitly sells disposable foodservice products, eco-friendly Karat Earth items, and custom/logistics services to restaurant chains, distributors, retail, online, and foodservice customers. Graphic Packaging is the best public reference/comparable because its filings explicitly identify cups, lids, food containers, and named QSR customers, but it is broader paperboard packaging rather than an obscure pure play. Clearwater Paper is a speculative upstream exception: its public disclosures indicate SBS paperboard used in liquid packaging, cups, plates, and food service, but it is below the preferred USD 300M cutoff and the restaurant-chain linkage must be verified through converters. UL Solutions is included as a regulatory/testing-gate candidate because food-contact, chemical, sustainability, and packaging compliance can become a gating function as restaurant chains shift materials; however, its exposure is broad and not restaurant-specific.
